name: a_part_is_turned_over_and_placed
why: BRIEFS R12 AND R21 (25/10/2026). An assembly of two halves could not be put together: «insert_component» places the centre of the box with no rotation, no operation moved or turned a component afterwards, and a distance mate «down» on «down» put the upper half underneath, with no way to ask for the other side and a verdict that did not say where the component went. «place_component» sets the origin and the axes of a component (read back after a rebuild), the state lists «axes» for every component, and «mate» takes «distance_side», measures the side on the two faces and answers «placement_after». Geometry: the base is 120x80x10, its box centred on the origin, so its upper face is at y 5. The cover is 120x80x4 from y 0 to y 4 in its part; turned 180 degrees about x with its origin at y 20, its face that looks up is at y 20 and the one that looks down at y 16.
defect_caught: A rotation written into the wrong numbers of Transform2 (rows taken for columns: the axes read back are not «+X -Y -Z»); an origin that is the box centre and not the origin; a placement the mates undid that is called done; a fixed component that is moved; «distance_side» that does not reach Flip, or a side measured on the wrong face, or with the normal of the part file instead of the assembly's.
